concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-005 (execute a permutation test with exactly 1,000 shuffles) is not linked to any task. The closest task is T011 (Nested Permutation Significance Test), but it is not tagged with [FR-005] and the description does not explicitly state the required 1,000 shuffles. Add a task (or tag) that directly satisfies FR-005.

Success Criterion SC-004 (SHAP value stability across k‑fold CV, std < 0.1) has no associated task. No task measures SHAP stability or records the standard deviation of mean SHAP values. Introduce a task to compute and verify this stability.

Success Criterion SC-005 (total pipeline compute time must be within the free‑tier CI limit) is not covered by any task. No task records overall wall‑clock time or validates it against the 6 h limit. Add a task to measure and assert total runtime.

Success Criterion SC-006 requires four visualizations (predicted‑vs‑actual, residual histogram, SHAP summary, parameter‑response curves). Only T012 (SHAP summary) and T013 (report generation) are present; the other three visualizations are missing. Add tasks to generate the predicted‑vs‑actual scatter, residual histogram, and parameter‑response curves, and ensure they are referenced in the report.

Task T014 is tagged with placeholder identifiers [P?] and [US?], which do not correspond to any defined priority or user story in the spec. Replace these placeholders with the correct priority (e.g., P3) and user story (e.g., US3) or remove them if not applicable.
Task T015 also uses placeholder tags [P?] and [US?] that are undefined. Update the tags to reference existing priorities/user stories or delete the placeholders.
